verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships SDKs and an OpenAI-compatible hosted API, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint and the CLI releases page do not show a versioning or deprecation commitment, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
